decisions.subject: Phase 3 accuracy: the primary measure, max build achieved for the case's own building type
decisions.operator_quote: MB-13 - this fine but you missed the most important measure is whether mxbuild was achieved for the build type that matches the case - how close from a new build sixplex does our sixplex match - more from a GFA. We need to determine if we actually achieved the max max build.
decisions.recommendation: Primary measure (operator): max build achieved for the case's own building type. For each case, compare our maximum building of the SAME type as the applicant's (e.g. our sixplex vs the applicant's new-build sixplex) with the applicant's proposal, GFA first, then height, storeys, footprint, units. Direction test (gate): where the City granted NO variance on GFA/FSI, height or storeys, the applicant's figure must be <= our maximum (else our maximum is too low); where the City granted a variance on that measure, the applicant's figure must be > our maximum (else our maximum is too high or the rule is missed). Threshold: >= 90 % of cases correct in direction, per measure, on each set; every wrong-direction case is a numbered finding. Closeness (measured): for new-build cases with no variance on the measure, report applicant / our maximum per case (median and spread). Its threshold is set from the regression set (MB-27) and recorded BEFORE the proof set (MB-28) is keyed or run; it is never set after the proof set's results.

decisions.subject: Phase 3 exit list and accuracy thresholds
decisions.operator_quote: MB-13 - this fine but you missed the most important measure is whether mxbuild was achieved for the build type that matches the case - how close from a new build sixplex does our sixplex match - more from a GFA. We need to determine if we actually achieved the max max build.
decisions.recommendation: Regression set (25) + proof set (>= 25 fresh cases, >= 130 rows, never used for fixing); catch metric with denominator frozen at manifest time, not-evaluated = missed; CAUGHT + CAUGHT-ESTIMATE >= 70 %, CAUGHT >= 50 %; false alarms <= 10 (0 on existing-lot minimums and existing/party walls); soft alarms <= 15; wrong limits <= 3 with named causes; a building for every permitted type except the named causes (LC map layer A0553/A0578; type not permitted); plausibility (out of bounds = fixed or "not evaluated: implausible"); oracles before the switch; SC-5 = the proof-set thresholds. Rule text: Phase 3 closes when, on a proof set never used for fixing, our maximum building of the applicant's own type is correct in direction against the City's decision on GFA/FSI, height and storeys in ≥ 90 % of cases, and the catch, false-alarm, wrong-limit, building and plausibility thresholds fixed in MB-13 are met; no threshold is set after the results it judges.

decisions.recommendation: YES, with the operator's principle. Values in the literal registry count as keyed only where a test proves the cited unit exists in the table and holds the same value. Operator principle (binding): everything the model uses is, for the most part, an existing by-law value.
